With the @runwayml plugin in Codex and ChatGPT, you can see how a character from your prototype moves, try a different opening shot for a trailer, or turn a product photo into a video ad.

Anthony Maggio shares how Runway’s marketing team is using ChatGPT Image to produce more assets each week.
